summary.headline: PPAP Automotive Q2 FY27 consolidated revenue rose 29.8% YoY to INR177.8 crores, but gross margin fell to 39.8% from 45.6%.
summary.overview: Consolidated revenue grew 29.8% YoY to INR177.8 crores in Q2 FY27 and PAT turned positive at INR2.5 crores versus a marginal loss a year earlier. Gross margin compressed about 580 bps YoY to 39.8%, which management attributed to raw material pass-through lag and a higher mix of lower-margin tooling and battery revenue. EBITDA rose 23% YoY to INR15.7 crores (8.8% margin), helped by operating leverage and lower net finance costs from treasury income on divestment proceeds. Management expects margin recovery in H2 as pending price revisions are settled, though it declined to quantify the EBITDA margin improvement.

segments.name: Automotive parts
segments.commentary: Largest revenue contributor; H1 lifetime order wins INR429 crores, including about INR300 crores in Q2. EV order wins rose to INR156.5 crores in H1 from about INR27 crores in H1 FY26. Standalone revenue growth was 24.4% in Q2.

segments.name: Aftermarket
segments.commentary: Q2 revenue grew 24% YoY; about 5% of group sales with a target of about 10% over coming years. 79 new products launched in Q2, 1,337 active SKUs, 154 distributors.

segments.name: Tooling (Meraki)
segments.commentary: Q2 revenue grew about 60% YoY to INR8.3 crores; 196 molds in order book valued at about INR40 crores after 50 new molds in Q2; capacity utilisation 86%. Business is being moved into a 100% subsidiary, Meraki Precision Tool Engineering Limited, via slump sale expected by end of Q3 FY27.

segments.name: Industrial products
segments.commentary: Q2 revenue grew about 64% to INR2.8 crores, about 2% of group revenue. Early exports to the US and Africa for sealing systems.

segments.name: Lithium-ion battery (Avinya)
segments.commentary: Q2 revenue INR6.6 crores versus INR1 crore a year earlier; EBITDA loss narrowed to INR30 lakhs from INR1.2 crores. Plant utilisation about 15%. Merger with PPAP expected by end of Q4 FY27.

guidance_outlook: H2 FY27 margin expected to improve from SOP ramp-ups and price recoveries; management declined to quantify EBITDA margin improvement due to raw material volatility.

About 68% of the approximately 380 bps auto-parts gross margin reduction has been recovered from customers; balance under negotiation, expected to settle during H2 FY27 (about 6 months lag). Management expects margin recovery by Q1 FY28.
New-SOP contribution to top line expected to rise from about 10% in H1 to about 15% in H2 FY27.
Battery business targeted to reach zero EBITDA in Q3 FY27.
Hutchinson sealing technology: first order-win breakthrough targeted in Q4 FY27.
Chennai plant expected fully operational by Q3 FY27; further capacity expansion to be evaluated in Q3 based on order book and utilisation.
Interim dividend of INR1.5 per equity share declared.
Two additional aftermarket regional warehouses planned (West and South) by end of FY27, with an East warehouse next year.
capex_capacity: Capacity utilisation about 78% in Q2 FY27 versus 73% in Q1 FY27 and 68% in Q2 FY26.
New Chennai plant progressing; expected fully operational by Q3 FY27.
Tooling plant utilisation 86% in Q2; battery plant utilisation about 15%.
Further capacity expansion to be decided in Q3 FY27 based on order book and utilisation.
Proceeds from JV stake divestment invested in short-term funds pending strategic deployment.
demand_pricing: Indian auto industry domestic sales grew 18.2% YoY to 83.88 lakh units in Q2, supported by GST 2.0 affordability.
Raw material costs elevated; pass-through to OEMs lags, raising reported revenue without proportionate gross profit, which mechanically dilutes margin percentage.
Battery business faces volatility in cell prices, cell quality consistency, pricing pressure and shorter delivery timelines.
Counterfeiting of aftermarket products has emerged in the market; company has issued newspaper notices and added packaging countermeasures.
Order books typically execute over 1 to 4 years; development cycle shortened from about 3 years to about 2 years.

qa_highlights.question: How will the INR429 crore H1 order wins translate into revenue over coming quarters?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said orders typically execute over 2 to 4 years, with some executing within 1 year; ramp-ups are led by Maruti and Tata Motors programs.

qa_highlights.question: Will gross margin recover, and when, given cost pass-through negotiations?
qa_highlights.answer: CFO said 380 bps of auto-parts gross margin was lost, 68% already recovered, balance in negotiation with about 6-month settlement lag; margin recovery expected by Q1 FY28.

qa_highlights.question: Can EBITDA margins improve further and by how much?
qa_highlights.answer: CFO declined to quantify, citing volatility, but expects significant H2 margin improvement from new SOPs and price recoveries.

qa_highlights.question: What is the progress on the Hutchinson sealing technology partnership?
qa_highlights.answer: Technical presentations held with customers in Q2; first Hutchinson-based order win targeted for Q4 FY27. Current wins rely on in-house products.

qa_highlights.question: What are the non-auto and export prospects for Industrial Products?
qa_highlights.answer: Targeting air handling units and electrical panels, including data-centre cooling demand; early exports to the US and African markets; about 30% of tooling revenue is from non-auto customers.

qa_highlights.question: What milestones are needed for the battery business to break even?
qa_highlights.answer: Management expects zero EBITDA in Q3 FY27, after Q2 EBITDA loss narrowed to INR30 lakhs.

qa_highlights.question: What is the customer pipeline with JSW, MG, VinFast, and Volkswagen?
qa_highlights.answer: Orders received from JSW standalone and JSW MG Motors (Windsor); VinFast supplied and new business under negotiation; Volkswagen platform not yet announced; Tata Motors new platforms underway.

qa_highlights.question: Progress on aftermarket target of 10% of revenue?
qa_highlights.answer: Aftermarket currently about 5% of revenue; 154 distributors, adding distributors in Q3 and Q4, with online presence via Amazon and Flipkart and warehouse expansion.

risks_watch: Gross margin recovery depends on settling pending OEM price revisions in H2 FY27; the lag is about 6 months.
Raw material and crude oil price volatility, linked to geopolitical disruptions, continues daily.
Battery business still loss-making; Q3 zero-EBITDA target and Avinya merger (by end Q4 FY27) subject to approvals.
Hutchinson-based order win is targeted for Q4 FY27 and has not yet been achieved.
Macro risks flagged by management: inflation, possible interest rate hikes, geopolitical uncertainty.
Counterfeiting of aftermarket products; watch distributor and online channel impact.
Higher share of low-margin tooling and battery revenue may continue to weigh on gross margin.
summary.management_tone: Confident on demand, order wins and operating momentum, but cautious and non-committal on margin quantification and timing of price recoveries. Management repeatedly stated that H2 margin improvement is expected but gave no numbers, citing raw material volatility.
key_quotes: It is important to note that the pass-through of increased raw material costs to customers results in a corresponding increase in reported revenue without a proportionate increase in gross profit.
So in H2, the margin would improve due to the two reasons.
And I am quite hopeful that in this quarter 3 also, we should be able to achieve a zero EBITDA kind of a situation, thereby eliminating all the losses at least on the operating level of the company.

adds.what: New Chennai plant (auto parts), expected fully operational

growth.why: No numeric revenue guidance; management expects H2 margin recovery (unquantified) from SOP ramp-ups and price recoveries (about 68% of the ~380 bps auto-parts margin hit already recovered), with the Chennai plant fully operational by Q3 FY27 and H1 order wins of INR429 crores, though the margin-recovery timing is only partly backed by specifics.

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.why: About 68% of the ~380 bps auto-parts gross margin hit is already recovered, the balance is in negotiation with a ~6-month lag, and management expects recovery by Q1 FY28, though it declined to quantify the EBITDA margin gain (Q2 EBITDA margin 8.8%, gross margin 39.8% vs 45.6%).

rows.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
rows.why: New Chennai auto-parts plant is under construction and expected fully operational by Q3 FY27; further expansion to be decided in Q3 based on order book and utilisation (78% in Q2).

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: H1 lifetime order wins of INR429 crores (about INR300 crores in Q2) and new-SOP share of revenue rising from ~10% in H1 to ~15% in H2 FY27, with standalone revenue up 26.7% in H1 and utilisation up to 78% from 68%.

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.why: Utilisation is 78%, just below the 80% threshold, and further expansion is explicitly to be evaluated in Q3 FY27 on order book and utilisation; JV divestment proceeds are sitting in short-term funds pending deployment.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: No numeric revenue guidance was given; H1 revenue rose 31.8% YoY and order wins are strong, but management has not raised any numbers and cited raw material volatility.

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: Gross margin fell ~580 bps YoY to 39.8% in Q2, price pass-through is lagging ~6 months, and management flagged inflation, possible rate hikes and crude/raw material volatility.

rows.label: New product launch
rows.why: 79 aftermarket products launched in Q2, 50 new molds added in Q2, and the first Hutchinson sealing-technology order win is targeted for Q4 FY27.

rows.label: Battery business reaches zero EBITDA
rows.why: Q2 EBITDA loss narrowed to INR30 lakhs from INR1.2 crores, but plant utilisation is only about 15% and cell price volatility remains; management is 'hopeful' rather than committed.

rows.label: Avinya battery merger and Meraki slump sale
rows.why: Avinya merger expected by end Q4 FY27 and Meraki tooling business transfer to a 100% subsidiary by end Q3 FY27, both subject to approvals.

rows.label: Aftermarket warehouses and distribution expansion
rows.why: Aftermarket is about 5% of group sales (Q2 revenue +24% YoY) with a target of ~10% over the coming years; West and South warehouses planned by end FY27 and an East warehouse next year.

tone.note: Management was confident on order wins, demand and the Chennai plant, but cautious and non-committal on quantifying the H2 margin recovery and its timing, citing raw material volatility; analysts pressed on margin recovery timing and the pass-through lag.
